lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Three distinct vertical columns of high-luminance, roughly circular spot clusters are visible posterior to the gill region, transitioning from a dense stochastic pattern on the head to an ordered 2D grid on the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and deep shadow below.

other_distinctive_markers: A dense distribution of significantly smaller, high-luminance spots is visible on the cranial region anterior to the gill slits, distinct from the larger lateral flank patterning.
